title: Reading and writing files
idea: The `fs` module lets your code read, write and manage files and folders. Every call touches the disk, so every call can fail.
points: `readFileSync` returns the data, `readFile` takes a callback, and `fs/promises` returns a promise.
Sync calls throw, callbacks get `err` first, promises reject. Prefer `await`.
Every error carries a `code`, such as `ENOENT` (missing) or `EACCES` (not allowed).

pitfalls: Do not check `existsSync` first: the file can vanish before you read it. Handle `ENOENT`.
Avoid `readFileSync` in a running server; the next page explains why.
Relative paths start from where you ran `node`, not from the script's folder.
